mapper.select: SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM net_site_order WHERE pay_code = #{payCode} AND status = #{status})

SELECT o.id, o.pay_code, o.user_id, o.only_code, o.status, o.total_amount, o.discount_amount, o.net_amount, o.begin_time, o.end_time, o.voucher_id, o.calc,
i.id AS item_id, i.rule_code, i.rule_name, i.unit_price, i.min_bill_duration, i.max_bill_duration, i.max_price, i.pay_code, i.only_code, i.only_code_port, i.total_duration, i.per_use_duration, i.per_use_start_time, i.create_time, i.update_time
FROM net_site_order o LEFT JOIN net_site_order_itemized i ON o.pay_code = i.pay_code WHERE o.status = #{status} ORDER BY begin_time DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO net_site_order (pay_code, user_id, only_code, status, total_amount, discount_amount, net_amount, begin_time, end_time, voucher_id, calc ) VALUES ( #{payCode}, #{userId}, #{onlyCode}, #{status}, #{totalAmount}, #{discountAmount}, #{netAmount}, #{beginTime}, #{endTime}, #{voucherId}, #{calc} )
mapper.update:
UPDATE net_site_order
pay_code = #{payCode}, user_id = #{userId}, only_code = #{onlyCode}, status = #{status},
total_amount = #{totalAmount}, discount_amount = #{discountAmount}, net_amount = #{netAmount},
begin_time = #{beginTime}, end_time = #{endTime},
voucher_id = #{voucherId}, calc = #{calc},
WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select:
SELECT o.id, o.pay_code, o.user_id, o.only_code, o.status, o.total_amount, o.discount_amount, o.net_amount, o.voucher_id, o.calc, o.begin_time, o.end_time,
i.id AS item_id, i.rule_code, i.rule_name, i.unit_price, i.min_bill_duration, i.max_bill_duration, i.max_price, i.pay_code AS item_pay_code, i.only_code AS item_only_code, i.only_code_port, i.total_duration, i.per_use_duration, i.per_use_start_time, i.create_time AS item_create_time, i.update_time
FROM ( SELECT * FROM net_site_order
AND user_id = #{userId} AND only_code = #{onlyCode} AND status = #{status}
ORDER BY begin_time DESC LIMIT 1 ) o LEFT JOIN net_site_order_itemized i ON o.pay_code = i.pay_code
